newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bull may offer dividend in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Bull may offer dividend in 1998.

text.p: French computer company Bull may offer a dividend in 1998 based on 1997 results and should pay one in 1999 for the 1998 year, company chairman Jean-Marie Descarpentries said on Tuesday.

"We think we will distribute a dividend in 1999 but in view of our favourable outlook, it could turn out that we will propose a distribution for the 1997 year," Descarpentries told reporters at a news conference.
Earlier on Tuesday, Bull reported a 1996 profit of 376 million francs despite a non-recurring loss of 661 million related to the restructuring of the micro-computer sector.
